notes.title: Display scaling issues
notes.content:
We understand that some of you may have issues with the screen appearing larger than normal. 

If you are on the Windows 10 operating system, please right click on the desktop and select Display Settings. 

Under Scale and Layout, change the size of text, apps and other items to 100%

The program should work as intended now. If you encounter anymore issues associated with this game, please let me know on my profile page or send an email to Jason.Carver@encore.com

notes.title: Windows 10 Creator Update fix released
notes.content:
Dear Hoyle Fans,

We have released an update which will fix the crashing / non launching issue when running this game on the Windows 10. Those who are logged into the Steam client will have this update downloaded immediately. 

If you encounter any problems as a result of this update, please let us know. We will respond to every post on the forums.

notes.title: Issues with Windows 10
notes.content:
Dear Players,

It has come to our attention that a recent update may have caused our Hoyle games to malfunction. While we're searching for the exact update that's at fault, we offer the following troubleshooting advice.

Go into your list of installed games on Steam. Find Hoyle Official Card Games in your game list. Left click the name of the game once. Then, right click and select "Delete local content"

Once the game is removed from your Steam client, please do the following:

Hold down the Windows key and press the letter R.

In the search box, type in %AppData% and press enter. Now find a folder named Webfoot. Double click on the Webfoot Folder and you will find a Hoyle Official Card Games folder. 

Send the Hoyle Official Card Games folder to the Recycle Bin and restart your computer. Once you are logged back into Steam, redownload your game.

The game should function correctly. If it does not work for you, please let us know on our discussion forums. 

Thank you. 

-Jason

notes.title: A brand new Hoyle experience!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We wanted to take this time to say thanks for the wonderful feedback that the community has given regarding the way the game looks. 

With this new update, we have improved the Hoyle user experience with a brand new interface, addtional characters, and a fully voiced character cast for each character. There are other little tid bits here and there that have been improved on as well.

Those of you who already have the game installed will receive this free upgrade. Customers buying the game who don't already own it will receive the new build of the game.

Thank you very much for your feedback. Please let us know in the forums if there is somethig you would like to see in our games.

notes.title: New Languages and More
notes.content: Hello, Hoyle fans! We’re pleased to announce that the newest update to Hoyle Official Card Games Collection adds French and German language support, as well as several bug fixes and AI improvements. Happy gaming!

notes.title: V 1.07 update has been released!
notes.content:
Here is a rundown of what has been changed in this version:

Languages: Hoyle Official Card Games Collection is now localized for English, German and French. The language can be selected from the games menu.

Solitaire: Added various options for some of the Solitaire Games.

Other various bug fixes as well to the overall experience to the game.

We would like to thank our customers for the feedback so far and hope you will continue to provide us feedback as we evolve the game into something you would like to play.
